week_headline: Gut health and cancer prevention dominate headlines as keto diets and organic food markets spark fresh debate

top10.claim: La dieta keto es más eficaz que otras a corto plazo si usted quiere perder peso
top10.verdict: Keto diets do tend to produce faster weight loss in the short term, mainly because cutting carbs reduces water retention and appetite. But by the 12-month mark, most studies show keto performs similarly to other calorie-controlled diets. Long-term adherence is the real challenge, and keto is not right for everyone.
top10.verdict_highlight: Short-term yes, long-term it evens out
sources: NEJM, 2003 - Foster et al., low-carb vs low-fat RCT
BMJ, 2018 - Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns
Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health - Diet Review: Ketogenic Diet
top10.global_opinion: In Spain and much of Latin America, where the Mediterranean diet is culturally dominant, keto is viewed with scepticism by mainstream nutrition bodies. In the US, keto remains broadly popular and is commercially well-supported. The UK's NHS does not recommend keto as a standard weight-loss approach but acknowledges short-term effectiveness.
top10.brit_take: We spent decades being told fat was the enemy, and now fat is the diet. The truth, as ever, is somewhere in the middle.

top10.claim: Growth in organic milk presents market challenges
top10.verdict: Organic milk sales have genuinely grown in several markets, and that growth does create real supply and pricing pressures for producers and retailers. However, calling it purely a challenge misses the other side — it also represents opportunity for farmers willing to transition. The picture varies a lot by country and market maturity.
top10.verdict_highlight: Growth creates pressure, but also real opportunity
sources: USDA Economic Research Service - Organic Dairy Market Trends
EFSA - Organic food production and safety assessments
FAO - The world of organic agriculture, statistics and emerging trends
top10.global_opinion: In the EU, organic milk production is actively subsidised and encouraged under the Common Agricultural Policy, making market growth generally positive for producers. In the US, organic dairy has faced oversupply issues that have squeezed smaller farms. In the UK, the Soil Association reports steady consumer demand growth but tight margins for producers remain a concern.
top10.brit_take: Organic milk costs nearly double at the supermarket, yet somehow the farmers are still struggling. The supply chain maths never quite adds up, does it.

top10.claim: Harvard - trained gut doctor eats these 4 foods every day to lower his colon cancer risk
top10.verdict: There is solid evidence that foods like fibre-rich legumes, wholegrains, cruciferous vegetables, and certain fermented foods are associated with lower colorectal cancer risk — so the underlying science is real. The issue is framing one doctor's personal plate as a universal prescription. These foods support gut health broadly, but no specific four-food combination has been validated as a colon cancer shield.
top10.verdict_highlight: Good foods, but no magic four-food formula
sources: World Cancer Research Fund - Colorectal Cancer Report 2023
JAMA Oncology, 2021 - Dietary fibre and colorectal cancer risk meta-analysis
Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health - Nutrition and Colon Cancer
Lancet, 2019 - Global burden of disease attributable to diet
top10.global_opinion: Japan, which has one of the lowest colorectal cancer rates globally, attributes much of this to a traditional diet high in fish, fermented foods, and vegetables — broadly consistent with the science. In the US, the American Cancer Society emphasises overall dietary patterns over individual superfoods. The NHS similarly focuses on increasing fibre and reducing red and processed meat rather than spotlighting specific foods.
top10.brit_take: We do love a doctor telling us to eat more vegetables, but we also know deep down that no single headline is going to fix a lifetime of Friday night takeaways.
